correctness.rationale: The physical mass metric Q=diag(eps)-eps eps^T/(1+sum eps) is positive definite and Q M_rel has strictly negative Hermitian part -diag(eps_i alpha_i), since Q(I+1 eps^T)=diag eps. With Z=dt M/2, exact source stability function R=(1-z)/(1-2z+2z^2) gives f(z)=-z/[(2z-1)(2z^2-3z+2)]. Both quadratic denominator modulus factors increase on moving left from imaginary axis, giving |f(z)|^2<=G(|z|²)=s/[(1+4s)(4s²+s+4)]. Its derivative is proportional to 1-2s²-8s³, with unique positive root s*=0.42904716474868 and maximum C*=0.17487257559622. The Cayley transform of Q^{1/2}ZQ^{-1/2} is contractive; von Neumann inequality yields ||f(Z)||_Q<=C* despite nonnormality. The alpha->0 one-species normal case with legitimate stiff step approaches the boundary. Independent SymPy derivative check and 80 independently assembled multi-species physical-matrix examples corroborated algebra and bound. Does not cover resolved branch, nonlinear forcing or transient errors.
